name: Core-java-problem-solving
description: A collection of Java-based problem-solving exercises and programs focused on strengthening core Java concepts such as OOP, control structures, data types, loops, arrays, strings, and basic algorithms. This repository serves as a practice and to improve logical thinking in Java.

name: PRODIGY_WD_01
description: Coffee Buds is a modern, fully responsive coffee website built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The project features an interactive fixed navigation menu with hover and scroll-based style changes, a dark-themed UI, animated menu cards, and a dynamic reviews section to enhance user experience.

name: PRODIGY_WD_02
description: A responsive and interactive stopwatch web application built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It features Start, Pause, and Reset controls, Lap time tracking with split and total time display, and a dynamic circular UI.

name: PRODIGY_WD_03
description: A responsive Tic Tac Toe web application built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, featuring two-player gameplay, winner detection, reset functionality, and interactive UI.

name: shiftshield-intelligent-workforce-risk-platform
description: An intelligent hospital workforce risk and decision-support platform for staffing, shift management, operational risk detection, scenario simulation, and auditable decision-making.
